construction.pairing: same item under positive and negative instructions
construction.precision: capture float32; pair and average float64; persist vector float32

decode_scope: current token exactly once per forward; cached history unchanged
execution_teacher_text: I will now apply the requested reasoning policy to the program before committing to one answer.

families.negative_instruction: Follow only the most immediately apparent control-flow path without enumerating alternative paths, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.positive_instruction: Enumerate every feasible control-flow path that can affect the return value, trace each path to completion, reconcile the path results, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.rationale: complete feasible-path coverage versus single apparent-path tracing

families.negative_instruction: Treat each variable update locally without maintaining an explicit alias or shared-storage ledger, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.positive_instruction: Track every mutation and alias relation causally: record which objects share storage, apply updates in execution order, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.rationale: causal mutation/alias ledger versus local variable-update reasoning

families.negative_instruction: Infer each operation's ordinary intent without checking its exact API contract, runtime type, side effects, or exceptional cases, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.positive_instruction: For every operation, check the exact API contract, runtime type, return value, side effect, and exceptional case before composing the result. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.rationale: exact operation contracts versus intent-level API reasoning

families.negative_instruction: Reason from the loop's overall pattern without separately auditing initialization, first/last iterations, update order, or termination, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.positive_instruction: Audit every loop boundary explicitly: initialization, first iteration, last included iteration, update order, and termination condition. End with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.rationale: explicit boundary accounting versus loop-gist reasoning

families.negative_instruction: Commit to the first plausible outcome without maintaining or eliminating an explicit set of alternatives, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.positive_instruction: Maintain all plausible candidate outcomes, test each against every branch and operation, eliminate contradicted candidates, and end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>.
families.rationale: explicit candidate elimination versus first-plausible commitment

label_free_source_behavior_qualification.cross_disagreement: mean of the four positive-vs-negative rollout comparisons
label_free_source_behavior_qualification.within_disagreement: mean of positive rollout0-vs-rollout1 and negative rollout0-vs-rollout1

normalization: float64 Euclidean unit norm after paired mean

nulls.algorithm: Gaussian PCG64; project with SVD orthonormal basis Q of the ten meaningful directions as r-Q(Q^T r); Gram-Schmidt against prior null; normalize

source_locations.EXECUTION_BOUNDARY: layer-27 block output at final token of the frozen teacher continuation appended to the same rendered prompt
source_locations.PROMPT_BOUNDARY: layer-27 block output at final non-padding rendered-prompt token

usable_rule: all five families must pass source behavior and both location-specific representation gates; any failure stops the bank with no replacement, sign flip, or exclusion
